title: Figure 16: MDA Airborne Laser in a Boeing 747-400F
description: Color photograph of a Boeing 747 with a large nose-mounted turret taking off from an airfield, landing gear extended, with buildings and parked aircraft in the background. Caption reads "Figure 16. MDA Airborne Laser in a Boeing 747-400F." Text discusses Navy free-electron laser work and the C-130 Advanced Tactical Laser.
